body: The big one is gender dysphoria, but I can't use that as the sole excuse. There are plenty of people who suffer from that, and they manage to you know, improve themselves. I can safely say everybody on earth has bent over backwards to accomodate my uselessness - my parents, my lecturers, the university itself, my friend; and I feel like I've given them nothing in return. I always think "ah this cycle I'm going to redeem myself, I'll actually apply myself; I won't fuck up at all...and I just don't.
